daily_story.headline: Ireland is wind-led at times, but still gas-backed.
daily_story.interpretation: The prototype signal shows a familiar Irish transition pattern: strong wind contribution, visible renewable progress, but continuing gas dependency for balancing and security of supply.

gas.narrative: Gas remains the shock absorber of the Irish electricity system. A serious monitor should show when gas is acting as backup, when it is dominant, and whether dependency is structurally declining.
